info.text:
Prepaid cards lend you nothing. So how do they profit?
Green Dot's fiscal 2025 revenue: $2.08B; interchange (swipe fees paid by merchants) was $184.6M, down from $380.0M in 2021.
Net interest income on balances: about $90M in 2025. Growth in 2025 came mainly from partner program fees while accountholder fees fell.
Example: a $7.95 monthly fee plus two cash reloads at up to $5.95 each = $19.85 a month (fee not waived).
Since April 2019, the CFPB Prepaid Rule requires a short fee chart before purchase.
Sources: Green Dot Form 10-K filings (FY2021-FY2025), Green Dot cardholder agreement, CFPB.
News and education, not financial advice.
